title: Thomas And The Angry Hearts reveal a father’s perspective on rebellion in ‘Perfect Rules’
htmlContent:
Thomas And The Angry Hearts have created a touching and personal song that speaks to anyone who has ever felt the pressure of expectations. "Perfect Rules," is like a heartfelt letter from a father to his son, exploring the heavy burden of strict rules and the struggle that comes with them.

The song has a warm, bittersweet feel and carries a hint of sadness. It feels intimate, almost as if you're overhearing a private moment where a parent expresses their feelings. The song skillfully balances emotions and restraint, highlighting a parent wanting to protect their children while realizing that too many rules can be harmful. The singer's voice expresses both love and regret.

https://open.spotify.com/track/65jFGk1nNr5aWXgk4Gleya?si=jHkbDTF3RQC_vwz1NNvOqw

There's a timeless quality to "Perfect Rules" that resonates with everyone, whether you're a parent or a child. Thomas And The Angry Hearts show that they are storytellers who aren't afraid to dive into the complexities of relationships. "Perfect Rules" is a heartfelt conversation and a reflection on the ever-changing bond between parents and children.
